name: Elemental Aid
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
So yer a big shot shaman now, eh? Ye've mastered the elements and want tae put 'em to good use? I think I got just the thing.

If ye want the elements' respect, ye gotta repay yer debts to 'em. They help you, you help them. And right now they need all the help they can get from those who would abuse their power.

Earth's rumblin', adventurer. It speaks of the quilboar amassin' for some ritual of terrible power. We need tae go investigate their kraul and see what they're up to. Bring me back whatever ye find.
narrative.objectives: Defeat Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul and collect information on the quilboar's plans.

quests.name: Storm, Earth, and Fire
quests.objectiveText: Collect 5 Twisted Fire Totems, 5 Twisted Earth Totems, 5 Twisted Air Totems, and 5 Twisted Water Totems for Veyric Thunderhame in Arathi Highlands.

quests.name: Heed My Call
quests.objectiveText: Use the Twisted Totems to put an end to the quilboar ritual.

quests.name: The Tempest's Weapons
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the Eye of the Tempest to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac Mountains.
